Name: Caffeine Tracker
Author: VROTEK OÜ
Description:
Caffeine Tracker tracks your caffeine intake and estimates its afterlife in your body, helping you judge whether another drink fits your planned bedtime.

Press a Stream Deck key to log a drink or hold to undo the last entry. Set your drink amounts, bedtime and how quickly your body processes caffeine. A status key shows estimated caffeine remaining and when it should fall below your chosen level for sleep. You can customise drink icons and add or edit past drinks. Everything stays on your device.

Actions.Name: Log drink
Actions.Tooltip: Log a dose of caffeine. Long-press to undo the most recent dose.

Actions.Name: Caffeine status
Actions.Tooltip: Show caffeine, a sleep estimate, both or a status face. Press to reveal the alternate view for five seconds.
